newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Sphinx says cannot give forecast.
newsitem.headline: Sphinx says cannot give forecast.

text.p: Ceramics and bathroom equipment maker NV Koninklijke Sphinx Gustavsberg said on Wednesday it was confident its restructuring would bear fruit but that it was unable to give a profit forecast for the year.
"Under the present circumstances it is not possible to give a forecast on the results for the current financial year," the company said in a statement.

Sphinx earlier posted a total 1996/97 net loss of 45.1 million guilders. It previously said it expected a 15 million guilder loss from ordinary operations plus an additional extraordinary restructuring charge of 30 million.
Sphinx said that despite difficult market conditions, particularly in Germany and France, it was confident that structural measures to improve its cost basis and market position would bear fruit.
But it added, "The implementation of the various measures will, however, require some time."
